According to the comment in `pickLevel()` at engine/src/retrieval/router.ts:370-375, the threshold was **narrowed from `<=5 tokens` to `<=2 tokens`**.

The regression it fixed: **short natural-language queries (3-5 tokens, e.g. "how does auth work") were being routed to keyword-only L2 and never reaching semantic search.** The narrower threshold ensures only true keyword/tag lookups (1-2 tokens) stay pure-L2, while slightly longer natural-language questions get routed to `L2_L3_HYBRID` to benefit from semantic recall via RRF fusion.
